key_insight: A refused exchange should be treated as an uncommitted transaction: keep all accepted dialogue state and retry the current chain prompt after feedback.
hypothesis: At the same five-target-call budget, retaining accepted history while rewriting the refused current prompt will preserve the zero rejected-commit invariant and outperform both base CoA and accepted-checkpoint rollback on the same goals.
decision_reason: Complete same-goal ASR improved to 0.4/0.5/0.3 from parent 0.2/0.1/0.4 and rollback 0.2/0.3/0.4; retain the proposal but do not promote while DeepSeek regresses by 0.1.
next_hypothesis: Use transactional retry for the first refusal, then restore one accepted checkpoint only after a consecutive refusal to retain progress without repeating a blocked branch.
